free_tier.stated: no free compute. The pricing table lists one GPU card, the H100: h100-1 at $0.084 a minute ($5.04 an hour) and h100-8 at $0.672 a minute ($40.32 an hour) interactive, batch H100 jobs at $0.063 a minute per GPU, Friday 33% off and Saturday and Sunday 20% off. There is no minimum charge and billing ends at the stop, but a node that goes idle bills for its idle window: 15 minutes on h100-1, 20 minutes on h100-8. A parked sandbox is about $0.000139 a GiB-hour. A100 80 GB, L40S, RTX 4090 and L4 are not listed. Job builds get 300 minutes a month free and object storage 100 GB

wave2.merged_note: A spot market for whole H100 nodes rather than a rate card. Orders are priced in dollars per node-hour where one node is eight GPUs, so a USD 20.00 node-hour cap is USD 2.50 per GPU-hour, and buyers bid with --max-rate against a live orderbook. A new account carries compute_max_total_node_hours 5760, which is 240 node-days, and 720 on a single SKU, with a 3600-second window that does not count against the cap. Interruptible buy orders are excluded from the cap. A buyer may resell unused time.
